issues.desc: background.md ## Conversational Texture states the user "chose option 2 - the tool defect fix story - explicitly deferring the runId-scheme migration", but no enumerated option-1/option-2 list for this top-level story-choice fork appears anywhere in the text. This numbering collides with the separately-numbered (1)/(2)/(3) list in ## Solution Tradeoffs, where the CHOSEN in-story technical solution is labeled "(1)" (align guard with floor) and "(2)" is the REJECTED material-scoped-runId approach. A fresh reader cannot tell whether Conversational Texture's "option 2" refers to the same enumeration as Solution Tradeoffs' "(2)", or a distinct, never-explicitly-listed top-level fork (e.g. "story A: runId migration" vs "story B: guard fix").

background.md ## Trigger Event uses the jargon term "full-3x2 quorum" without ever defining what "3x2" stands for (e.g. 3 review rounds x 2 independent hosts). The term does not appear anywhere in CLAUDE.md either, so a fresh reader has no source to infer it from. This is peripheral scene-setting and does not block understanding of the core guard/floor predicate-mismatch defect, which is otherwise explained precisely with verified code-line references.
